text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
The image of North Flight's previous 
defeat must still linger in the minds of 
everyone who is supporting me, after all.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Today, I'll be the 'me' worthy of victory! 
—I'm going to make everyone's hearts 
flutter!
